extDesc.message: Cast this tab to a Chromecast / Google TV and control the TV. Works with the Fling app (Windows, Linux).

cmdCastTab.message: Cast this tab to the TV

offlineBody.message: This extension talks to the Fling app. Start Fling on this computer and it connects on its own.

openVideoPage.message: Open a tab in your browser, then try again.

needCatt.message: Fling needs catt — open the Fling panel.

pairHint.message: Pair once with the TV to unlock apps, the d-pad, and typing.

scrollHint.message: or scroll here to move around the TV

optShareTabs.message: Let Fling see which tab is open

optShareTabsHint.message: Lets the panel's “Cast this tab” and the system-wide shortcut work with this browser. The address goes only to the Fling app on this computer (127.0.0.1), never to the internet. Private windows are never shared.

optPause.message: Pause the video here after casting

optPauseHint.message: So the sound doesn't play twice.

optPortHint.message: Only if bridge_port in fling.json is different.

optShortcut.message: Change the shortcut (Alt+Shift+C by default) on the browser's extension shortcuts page.

credit.message: Fling by Damion Rashford and Tatiana · unofficial port by orfixe

optNotifyHint.message: A Windows / desktop notification from the Fling app with the new title. Same switch as “Notify when the video changes” in the Fling panel.
